channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kendrick Nunn | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kendrick Nunn from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Lonnie Walker on Kendrick Nunn
item.description:
Dionysis Aravantinos:Lonnie Walker:

“I’ll put my money on Kendrick Nunn as the best player in the EuroLeague right now.”

Lonnie Walker on Kendrick Nunn, Dec 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @AravantinosDA.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Kendrick Nunn
item.description:
O’Neal said of Hachimura.

“I mean, you know we gave up Kendrick Nunn – he wasn’t really doing nothing, but listen – I’m going to get on my Spice [Adams] thing right now. My Lakers, we all about winning them championships.“If it ain’t no piece that gon’ win a championship, I don’t want to see it. I don’t even know who that is.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Kendrick Nunn, Jan 27, 2023. Source: Lakers Daily.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Kendrick Nunn
item.description:
Anthony Davis:

“What could we have been if I was healthy all year, LeBron, Kendrick Nunn? You think about those things. When we put this team together, we looked really good on paper, but we haven't had a chance to reach that potential with guys being in and out of the lineup.”

Anthony Davis on Kendrick Nunn, Apr 3, 2022. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Frank Vogel on LeBron James, Kendrick Nunn
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Vogel on Kendrick Nunn’s absence (out for at least 2/3 weeks):

“Kendrick is a hell of a player, and we had him penciled in as a rotation player… I loved the idea of him playing off Russ and LeBron … (tough) loss for us.”

Frank Vogel on LeBron James, Kendrick Nunn, Oct 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Ben Simmons, Duncan Robinson, Kendrick Nunn, Tyler Herro
item.description:
one Western Conference coach told HoopsHype.

“I think Simmons is more versatile. I’d just surround him with shooters and open the floor up like Milwaukee for Giannis. There can be more creativity with Simmons on the offensive end. I would try to trade Embiid to Miami and get some of their young, hungry shooters and guards like Tyler Herro, Kendrick Nunn, Duncan Robinson, etc. Ideally, I’d get Bam, but I doubt Miami would trade him.”

Joel Embiid on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Ben Simmons, Duncan Robinson, Kendrick Nunn, Tyler Herro, Aug 24, 2020. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Duncan Robinson on Kendrick Nunn
item.description:
Barry Jackson:Duncan Robinson, on Bam and Nunn, who remain away from the team:

“I know those guys have been staying in shape. We're itching and excited to get them back.”

Duncan Robinson on Kendrick Nunn, Jul 20, 2020. Source: Twitter @flasportsbuzz.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Kendrick Nunn
item.description:
“Look at the mother-----r K-Nunn. Look at him. He’s got so much of me in him that it’s scary because his confidence continues to grow,”

Jimmy Butler on Kendrick Nunn, Nov 4, 2019. Source: Yahoo! Sports.
